latin: Potuerunt tres personae diuinae simul suppositare unam naturam.

mentions.context: The three divine persons together could have supposited a single nature. Potuerunt tres personae divinae simul suppositare unam naturam.²¹ Everyone agreed that there are three supposits in the Trinity, not one just one—a single supposit for each divine person.
